# Coding-agent instructions

Follow the repository-wide instructions in `/AGENTS.md`.

For any material decision, read `/docs/knowledge-core-integration.md` and use the connected GitHub integration to inspect the current `DataRaul/knowledge-core` repository before treating the decision as Brain-informed.

Do not bypass the reasoning-coverage manifest, provenance, missing-evidence checks, or Brain-failure classification required by that protocol. Trivial implementation choices do not require the full Brain gate.
